mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds Rate above 4% in the month preceding the forecast period coincides with a short-term discount rate shock that reduces the present value of future equity cash flows, thereby depressing near-term S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% in the preceding month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from a pre-signal baseline (p > 0.05) in periods where FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent declines in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) below 200 over two consecutive months signal deflationary expectations, which lower inflation premia and drive positive S&P 500 forward returns in the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL falls below 200 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in at least 60% of similar deflationary trigger events (rolling IC < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs in a month is interpreted as a labor market strengthening that reduces risk premia and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above 200,000 in a single month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite PAYEMS > 200,000 in 80% of similar monthly spikes (rolling IC < -0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) index below 90 for two consecutive months indicates weakening aggregate demand, which raises real interest rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 90 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during similar INDPRO contractions (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A multi-month decline in manufacturing activity (GDPC1) below 100 suggests supply-side constraints that prolong market uncertainty, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls below 100 for three consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >70% of analogous GDPC1 contraction episodes (rolling IC > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both employment (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) above 150,000 and 700, respectively, indicates dual demand channels that lower risk aversion and drive positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 150,000 AND HOUST > 700 in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both proxies meet the trigger in non-recessionary regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment claims (UNRATE) above 5% in a month signals labor market weakness that increases perceived risk and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 5.0% in a single month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not negative in >80% of similar UNRATE spikes (rolling IC < -0.2).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% for two consecutive months coincides with central bank accommodation and typically precedes a 60-day window of positive S&P 500 forward returns as market anticipates rate cuts.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.0% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of analogous UNRATE declines (rolling IC < -0.15).
